title: Fit thresholds and issue support-aware qualification records
summary: Measure each semantic family on the frozen corpus and produce qualification records only when predeclared targets and support requirements hold. Treat threshold fitting, held-out checking and runtime applicability as separate steps, avoiding confidence-only admission or copied benchmark numbers.
in_scope: Training-only threshold selection and held-out family reports
Support counts, clustered uncertainty, abstention and certificate creation
out_of_scope: Promoting failed qualification because a threshold happens to exist
implementation: Declare targets, accepted-error costs, eligible classes/domains, minimum independent episode support, confidence measure and interval procedure before selecting thresholds.
Fit thresholds on the tuning split, including separate affirmative and negative proposition regions where appropriate; retain all tried configurations.
Evaluate the selected procedure on qualification episodes with accepted accuracy, coverage, per-class mistakes, abstention and provider-error denominators.
Use episode/provenance-aware uncertainty estimates and mark insufficient support explicitly, including zero-error samples too small to establish the target.
Issue passing certificates with exact semantic/model/preparation identities and failure reports otherwise; invalidate affected certificates on failed drift checks.

acceptance.criterion: Failed or insufficient-support evaluation never issues a usable passing certificate.
acceptance.verification: Use high-confidence wrong, empty-acceptance and tiny zero-error datasets and inspect gate records.

acceptance.criterion: Threshold selection cannot read final evaluation outcomes.
acceptance.verification: Instrument partition access and assert that fitting sees only the declared tuning cases.

acceptance.criterion: Reports preserve accepted coverage, class errors, failure counts and independent episode support.
acceptance.verification: Recompute metrics from receipts and verify denominators plus the declared resampling unit.

tests: Duplicating each message does not double independent support.
A new renderer cannot reuse an old certificate.
A confidence measure change requires a new qualification procedure.
risks: Repeatedly checking the same held-out split turns it into tuning data.
Aggregate calibration can conceal a weak rare class.

reuse.application: Retain its threshold-only admission gap as a regression target.
Borrow fit/report/check workflow ideas without importing simulated results.
